reasoning_steps: Identify the goal: Boris wants to increase his pocket money.
Understand the effect of each magic wand: +1 increases money by 1 €, -1 decreases money by 1 €, and •2 doubles the money.
Determine the sequence that maximizes the money: Start with the wand that doubles the money, then decrease it, and finally increase it.
Option A: +1, -1, •2. This results in a net gain of 0 €.
Option B: +1, •2, -1. This results in a net gain of 1 €.
Option C: •2, +1, -1. This results in a net gain of 2 €.
Option D: •2, -1, +1. This results in a net gain of 2 €.
Option E: +1, •2, -1. This results in a net gain of 2 €.
